f.title: Include key PV activities in the quality assurance system
f.statement: With risk control as the aim, the MAH shall include key PV activities in the quality assurance system, focusing on: a suitable organisation; staff, equipment and resources; compliant management procedures; comprehensive, clear and workable SOPs; effective channels for collecting suspected ADR information; compliant reporting and handling; effective signal identification and assessment; effective control of identified risks; and PV documents and records that are accessible, reviewable and traceable.

rows.quote:
第八条 　持有人应当以防控风险为目的，将药物警戒的关键活动纳入质量保证系统中，重点考虑以下内容：
 （一）设置合理的组织机构；
 （二）配备满足药物警戒活动所需的人员、设备和资源；
 （三）制定符合法律法规要求的管理制度；
 （四）制定全面、清晰、可操作的操作规程；
 （五）建立有效、畅通的疑似药品不良反应信息收集途径；
 （六）开展符合法律法规要求的报告与处置活动；
 （七）开展有效的风险信号识别和评估活动；
 （八）对已识别的风险采取有效的控制措施；
 （九）确保药物警戒相关文件和记录可获取、可查阅、可追溯。

f.statement: The PV responsible person is responsible for operating and continuously improving the PV system and ensuring it complies with laws and this GVP, with main duties: ensuring compliant ADR monitoring and reporting; supervising risk identification, assessment and control and the effective execution of risk-control measures; managing safety communication so it is timely and effective; ensuring smooth communication channels internally and with regulators and ADR monitoring bodies; and reviewing or signing off important PV documents.

 （二）监督开展药品安全风险识别、评估与控制，确保风险控制措施的有效执行；
 （三）负责药品安全性信息沟通的管理，确保沟通及时有效；

 （五）负责重要药物警戒文件的审核或签发。

f.statement: The MAH shall prioritise signals, evaluating first those that may affect the benefit-risk balance or public health; prioritisation may consider seriousness, severity, outcome, reversibility and preventability; exposure and expected frequency; exposure in high-risk groups and different use patterns; impact of stopping treatment and availability of alternatives; expected risk-control measures; and applicability to other drugs of the class.

第五十九条 　持有人应当对信号进行优先级判定。对于其中可能会影响产品的获益-风险平衡，或对公众健康产生影响的信号予以优先评价。信号优先级判定可考虑以下因素：
 （一）药品不良反应的严重性、严重程度、转归、可逆性及可预防性；
 （二）患者暴露情况及药品不良反应的预期发生频率；
 （三）高风险人群及不同用药模式人群中的患者暴露情况；
 （四）中断治疗对患者的影响，以及其他治疗方案的可及性；
 （五）预期可能采取的风险控制措施；
 （六）适用于其他同类药品的信号。

f.title: Evaluate detected signals using all relevant information
f.statement: The MAH shall aggregate relevant information and evaluate detected signals to judge whether they constitute a new drug safety risk.

rows.quote: 第六十条 　持有人应当综合汇总相关信息，对检测出的信号开展评价，综合判断信号是否已构成新的药品安全风险。

f.title: May run post-authorisation safety studies to obtain further signal information
f.statement: When necessary, the MAH may obtain more information by conducting post-marketing safety studies.

rows.quote: 必要时，持有人可通过开展药品上市后安全性研究等方式获取更多信息。

'可' = Permitted. rows.quote_en: When necessary, the holder may obtain further information by conducting post-marketing drug safety studies or by other means.

f.title: Investigate clusters of similar reactions in the same or adjacent batches
f.statement: When the MAH becomes aware of or detects multiple suspected reactions with similar clinical manifestations concentrated in a short period for the same drug of the same (or adjacent) batch number, it shall promptly conduct case analysis and investigation.

rows.deadline: Promptly
rows.quote: 第六十一条 　持有人获知或发现同一批号（或相邻批号）的同一药品在短期内集中出现多例临床表现相似的疑似不良反应，呈现聚集性特点的，应当及时开展病例分析和情况调查。

rows.quote_en: Article 61 Where the holder becomes aware of or discovers that multiple suspected adverse reactions with similar clinical manifestations have occurred in a short period with the same drug of the same batch number (or adjacent batch numbers), showing clustering, it shall promptly conduct case analysis and investigation.

f.title: Assess new safety risks promptly considering benefit-risk
f.statement: The MAH shall promptly assess new safety risks, analyse influencing factors, characterise the risk, determine its type and assess whether risk-control measures are needed, taking the overall benefit-risk balance into account.

rows.quote: 第六十二条 　持有人应当及时对新的药品安全风险开展评估，分析影响因素，描述风险特征，判定风险类型，评估是否需要采取风险控制措施等。评估应当综合考虑药品的获益-风险平衡。
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: confirmed against the Chinese text: actor, modal ('应当' = shall) and content match. Below 90: Chinese quote with English statement (translation). Bilingual review: re-translation agrees; level follows the Chinese modal (应当/应/不得); statement adds nothing; earlier hold below 90 for being a translation is lifted per GUIDE "Non-English sources".
rows.quote_en: Article 62 The holder shall promptly assess new drug safety risks, analyse influencing factors, describe the risk characteristics, determine the type of risk, and assess whether risk-control measures need to be taken, etc. The assessment shall take the benefit-risk balance of the drug into account comprehensively.

f.title: Analyse causes and risk factors to inform the PV plan
f.statement: The MAH shall analyse causes or factors that may cause a risk or increase its frequency or severity, such as patient physiology, underlying disease, concomitant drugs, solvent, storage or mode of use, to provide a scientific basis for PV plans; TCM and ethnic-medicine MAHs shall analyse prescription characteristics, clinical use and patient factors according to the relevant theories.

rows.actor: MAH (including TCM and ethnic medicine MAHs)
rows.quote:
第六十三条 　持有人应当分析可能引起药品安全风险、增加风险发生频率或严重程度的原因或影响因素，如患者的生理特征、基础疾病、并用药品，或药物的溶媒、储存条件、使用方式等，为药物警戒计划的制定和更新提供科学依据。
 中药、民族药持有人应当根据中医药、民族医药相关理论，分析处方特点（如炮制方式、配伍等）、临床使用（如功能主治、剂量、疗程、禁忌等）、患者机体等影响因素。
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: confirmed against the Chinese text: actor, modal ('应当' = shall) and content match. Below 90: Chinese quote with English statement (translation). Bilingual review: re-translation agrees; level follows the Chinese modal (应当/应/不得); statement adds nothing; earlier hold below 90 for being a translation is lifted per GUIDE "Non-English sources".
rows.quote_en:
Article 63 The holder shall analyse the causes or influencing factors that may give rise to a drug safety risk or increase its frequency or severity, such as the patient's physiological characteristics, underlying diseases and concomitant medicines, or the drug's solvent, storage conditions and mode of use, so as to provide a scientific basis for formulating and updating the pharmacovigilance plan.
Holders of traditional Chinese medicines and ethnic medicines shall, on the basis of the relevant theories of traditional Chinese medicine and ethnic medicine, analyse influencing factors such as prescription characteristics (e.g. processing methods, compatibility), clinical use (e.g. functions and indications, dose, course of treatment, contraindications) and the patient's constitution.

f.title: Risk characterisation may cover mechanism, frequency, severity, preventability, controllability, impact and evidence
f.statement: The description of a drug risk's characteristics may include the mechanism of the risk, its frequency, severity, preventability and controllability, the scope of its impact on patients or public health, and the strength and limitations of the risk evidence.

rows.quote: 第六十四条 　对药品风险特征的描述可包括风险发生机制、频率、严重程度、可预防性、可控性、对患者或公众健康的影响范围，以及风险证据的强度和局限性等。

rows.quote_en: Article 64 The description of the characteristics of a drug risk may include the mechanism, frequency, severity, preventability and controllability of the risk, the extent of its impact on patient or public health, and the strength and limitations of the evidence for the risk, etc.

f.title: Prioritise assessment of important risks and assess important missing information
f.statement: Risks are identified or potential; risks that may affect benefit-risk or harm public health shall be prioritised for assessment as important risks. The MAH shall also assess important missing information that may constitute a risk.

rows.quote:
第六十五条 　风险类型分为已识别风险和潜在风险。对于可能会影响产品的获益-风险平衡，或对公众健康产生不利影响的风险，应当作为重要风险予以优先评估。
 持有人还应当对可能构成风险的重要缺失信息进行评估。
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: confirmed. Below 90: Chinese quote with English statement (translation). Also: first sentence is a definition (risk types); second is passive; only the third names the MAH. Bilingual review: re-translation agrees; held at 86: first sentence is a classification, duty partly descriptive.
rows.quote_en:
Article 65 Risks are classified as identified risks and potential risks. Risks that may affect the benefit-risk balance of the product or have an adverse impact on public health shall be assessed with priority as important risks.
The holder shall also assess important missing information that may constitute a risk.

f.title: Apply risk management measures based on risk assessment results
f.statement: Based on risk assessment results, the MAH shall take appropriate risk management measures for identified and potential risks.

rows.quote: 第六十六条 　持有人应当根据风险评估结果，对已识别风险、潜在风险等采取适当的风险管理措施。

rows.quote_en: Article 66 The holder shall take appropriate risk management measures for identified risks, potential risks, etc. on the basis of the results of risk assessment.

f.title: Document risk assessments in a record or report
f.statement: Risk assessments shall be documented as records or reports, generally covering risk overview, causes, process, results and risk management recommendations.

rows.quote: 第六十七条 　风险评估应当有记录或报告，其内容一般包括风险概述、原因、过程、结果、风险管理建议等。

rows.quote_en: Article 67 Risk assessments shall be recorded or reported; their content generally includes a risk overview, causes, process, results, risk management recommendations, etc.

f.title: Take urgent control measures and report to the provincial regulator for serious risks
f.statement: If at any stage of risk identification and assessment the MAH considers that a risk may seriously endanger patient life or public health, it shall immediately take risk-control measures such as suspending production and sale and recalling products, and report to the provincial drug regulator where it is located.

rows.deadline: Immediately
rows.quote: 第六十八条 　在药品风险识别和评估的任何阶段，持有人认为风险可能严重危害患者生命安全或公众健康的，应当立即采取暂停生产、销售及召回产品等风险控制措施，并向所在地省级药品监督管理部门报告。

rows.quote_en: Article 68 Where, at any stage of drug risk identification and assessment, the holder considers that a risk may seriously endanger patients' lives or public health, it shall immediately take risk-control measures such as suspending production and sale and recalling products, and report to the provincial drug regulatory department where it is located.

f.title: Interventional PASS may follow GCP
f.statement: Post-marketing safety studies are generally non-interventional but may be interventional; interventional studies may be conducted with reference to GCP requirements.

rows.quote: 第七十条 　药品上市后安全性研究一般是非干预性研究，也可以是干预性研究，一般不涉及非临床研究。干预性研究可参照《药物临床试验质量管理规范》的要求开展。

Interventional studies may be conducted with reference to the requirements of the Good Clinical Practice for Drug Clinical Trials [药物临床试验质量管理规范].

f.title: Conduct PASS proactively or as required, not for promotion
f.statement: The MAH shall proactively conduct post-marketing safety studies according to the drug risk, or as required by provincial or higher regulators; such studies and their activities must not aim at product promotion.

rows.quote: 第七十一条 　持有人应当根据药品风险情况主动开展药品上市后安全性研究，或按照省级及以上药品监督管理部门的要求开展。药品上市后安全性研究及其活动不得以产品推广为目的。

Post-marketing drug safety studies and their activities shall not be for the purpose of product promotion.

f.title: Comply with ethics and subject protection in PASS
f.statement: The MAH shall comply with laws and requirements on ethics and subject protection and ensure the rights and interests of subjects.

rows.quote: 第七十三条 　持有人应当遵守伦理和受试者保护的相关法律法规和要求，确保受试者的权益。

f.title: Select appropriate PASS methods; primary or secondary data allowed
f.statement: The MAH shall choose appropriate post-marketing safety study methods according to study aims, risk profile and clinical use; studies may use primary data collected directly from healthcare professionals or patients, or secondary data collected earlier for other purposes.

rows.quote: 第七十四条 　持有人应当根据研究目的、药品风险特征、临床使用情况等选择适宜的药品上市后安全性研究方法。药品上市后安全性研究可以基于本次研究中从医务人员或患者处直接收集的原始数据，也可以基于本次研究前已经发生并且收集的用于其他研究目的的二手数据。

rows.quote_en: Article 74 The holder shall select a suitable post-marketing drug safety study method according to the study objectives, the drug's risk profile, clinical use, etc. A post-marketing drug safety study may be based on primary data collected directly from healthcare professionals or patients in the study, or on secondary data that arose and were collected before the study for other research purposes.

f.title: Write a PASS protocol approved by the PV responsible person
f.statement: The MAH shall prepare a written protocol for post-marketing safety studies, drafted by persons with suitable background and experience and reviewed or approved by the PV responsible person.

rows.quote: 第七十五条 　持有人开展药品上市后安全性研究应当制定书面的研究方案。研究方案应当由具有适当学科背景和实践经验的人员制定，并经药物警戒负责人审核或批准。

f.statement: For post-marketing safety studies required by regulators, protocols and reports shall be submitted as the regulators require.

rows.quote: 第七十六条 　对于药品监督管理部门要求开展的药品上市后安全性研究，研究方案和报告应当按照药品监督管理部门的要求提交。

f.title: Monitor safety during studies and assess new benefit-risk information

rows.quote: 第七十七条 　持有人应当监测研究期间的安全性信息，发现任何可能影响药品获益-风险平衡的新信息，应当及时开展评估。

f.statement: When a study finds a safety problem that may seriously endanger patient life or public health, the MAH shall immediately take risk-control measures such as suspending production and sale and recalling products, and report to the provincial drug regulator where it is located.

rows.quote: 第七十八条 　研究中发现可能严重危害患者的生命安全或公众健康的药品安全问题时，持有人应当立即采取暂停生产、销售及召回产品等风险控制措施，并向所在地省级药品监督管理部门报告。

f.title: Prepare PSURs per the PSUR writing standard
f.statement: PSURs shall be based on work done by the MAH in the reporting period, review, summarise and analyse safety information comprehensively, and follow the format and content of the PSUR writing standard.

rows.quote: 第七十九条 　定期安全性更新报告应当以持有人在报告期内开展的工作为基础进行撰写，对收集到的安全性信息进行全面深入的回顾、汇总和分析，格式和内容应当符合药品定期安全性更新报告撰写规范的要求。

f.title: PSUR frequency: yearly until first re-registration for new drugs, then 5-yearly
f.statement: Innovative and improved new drugs shall submit a PSUR every full year from the date of approval until first re-registration, then every 5 years. f.title: PSMF minimum content
f.statement: The PSMF shall contain at least: organisation; PV responsible person details (residence region, contact details, CV, duties); full-time staffing; sources of suspected ADR information; IT tools or systems; policies and SOPs with an index; operation of the PV system; delegated PV activities with a list of agreements; quality management (objectives, QA system, control indicators, internal audits); annexes including procedures, product list, agreements, audit reports and the PSMF revision log.

rows.quote:
第一百零六条 　药物警戒体系主文件应当至少包括以下内容：
 （一）组织机构：描述与药物警戒活动有关的组织架构、职责及相互关系等；
 （二）药物警戒负责人的基本信息：包括居住地区、联系方式、简历、职责等；
 （三）专职人员配备情况：包括专职人员数量、相关专业背景、职责等；
 （四）疑似药品不良反应信息来源：描述疑似药品不良反应信息收集的主要途径、方式等；
 （五）信息化工具或系统：描述用于开展药物警戒活动的信息化工具或系统；
 （六）管理制度和操作规程：提供药物警戒管理制度的简要描述和药物警戒管理制度及操作规程目录；
 （七）药物警戒体系运行情况：描述药品不良反应监测与报告，药品风险的识别、评估和控制等情况；
 （八）药物警戒活动委托：列明委托的内容、时限、受托单位等，并提供委托协议清单；
 （九）质量管理：描述药物警戒质量管理情况，包括质量目标、质量保证系统、质量控制指标、内审等；
 （十）附录：包括制度和操作规程文件、药品清单、委托协议、内审报告、主文件修订日志等。

After the report has been submitted, the serious adverse reaction shall continue to be followed up, and relevant new information or changes to the previous report shall be reported promptly as follow-up reports, within 15 days of obtaining the new information.

f.title: Expedite when sponsor or investigator cannot exclude relatedness, and other SUSAR sources
f.statement: If the sponsor and investigator disagree on causality and either cannot exclude a relationship, expedited reporting is required. SAEs occurring after trial or follow-up end and before the review decision are reported by the investigator to the sponsor and, if SUSARs, expedited. SUSARs from other sources related to the trial drug shall also be expedited.

rows.quote:
第一百二十五条 　申办者和研究者在不良事件与药物因果关系判断中不能达成一致时，其中任一方判断不能排除与试验药物相关的，都应当进行快速报告。
 在临床试验结束或随访结束后至获得审评审批结论前发生的严重不良事件，由研究者报告申办者，若属于可疑且非预期严重不良反应，也应当进行快速报告。
 从其他来源获得的与试验药物相关的可疑且非预期严重不良反应也应当进行快速报告。
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: confirmed. Below 90: Chinese quote with English statement (translation). Also: duties are impersonal ('都应当进行快速报告'); the second paragraph puts reporting on the investigator, the expedited report on the sponsor (inferred). Bilingual review: re-translation agrees; held at 88: several actors and passive clauses; investigator duty stated without modal (由研究者报告).
rows.quote_en:
Article 125 Where the sponsor and the investigator cannot agree in judging the causal relationship between an adverse event and the drug, and either party judges that a relationship with the investigational drug cannot be excluded, expedited reporting shall be made.
Serious adverse events occurring after the end of the clinical trial or of follow-up and before the review and approval conclusion is obtained are reported by the investigator to the sponsor; if they are suspected unexpected serious adverse reactions, expedited reporting shall also be made.
Suspected unexpected serious adverse reactions related to the investigational drug obtained from other sources shall also be reported on an expedited basis.

f.title: Submit complete ICSRs electronically to CDE
f.statement: Individual safety reports shall be complete, standardised and accurate; the sponsor shall submit them to the national drug review agency by electronic transmission.

rows.actor: Sponsor (drug registration applicant approved to conduct clinical trials)
rows.quote:
第一百二十六条 　个例安全性报告内容应当完整、规范、准确，符合相关要求。
 申办者向国家药品审评机构提交个例安全性报告应当采用电子传输方式。
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: confirmed. Below 90: Chinese quote with English statement (translation). Also: first sentence passive. Bilingual review: re-translation agrees; level follows the Chinese modal (应当/应/不得); statement adds nothing; earlier hold below 90 for being a translation is lifted per GUIDE "Non-English sources". Score 90: quote has no grammatical subject; actor follows from the chapter.
rows.quote_en:
Article 126 The content of individual case safety reports shall be complete, standardised and accurate, and meet the relevant requirements.
The sponsor shall submit individual case safety reports to the national drug evaluation institution by electronic transmission.

f.title: Report other potentially serious safety risk information promptly
f.statement: Beyond SUSAR ICSRs, the sponsor shall make a scientific judgement on other potentially serious safety risk information and report it to the national drug review agency as soon as possible; this generally means information that clearly affects benefit-risk, may change use, or affects overall development.

rows.actor: Sponsor (drug registration applicant approved to conduct clinical trials)
rows.deadline: As soon as possible
rows.quote:
第一百二十七条 　除非预期严重不良反应的个例安全性报告之外，对于其他潜在的严重安全性风险信息，申办者也应当作出科学判断，同时尽快向国家药品审评机构报告。
 一般而言，其他潜在的严重安全性风险信息指明显影响药品获益-风险评估的、可能考虑药品用法改变的或影响总体药品研发进程的信息。
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: confirmed against the Chinese text: actor, modal ('应当' = shall) and content match. Below 90: Chinese quote with English statement (translation). Bilingual review: re-translation agrees; level follows the Chinese modal (应当/应/不得); statement adds nothing; earlier hold below 90 for being a translation is lifted per GUIDE "Non-English sources".
rows.quote_en:
Article 127 In addition to individual case safety reports of suspected unexpected serious adverse reactions, the sponsor shall also make a scientific judgement on other potentially serious safety risk information and at the same time report it to the national drug evaluation institution as soon as possible.
In general, other potentially serious safety risk information means information that clearly affects the benefit-risk assessment of the drug, may lead to consideration of a change in the use of the drug, or affects the overall drug development process.

f.title: Analyse safety information and aggregate data periodically in trials
f.statement: The sponsor shall analyse and assess safety information to identify risks, considering patient population, indication, natural history, existing treatments and benefit-risk in case assessment, and shall periodically aggregate and analyse safety data to assess risk.

rows.actor: Sponsor (drug registration applicant approved to conduct clinical trials)
rows.quote: 第一百二十八条 　申办者应当对安全性信息进行分析和评估，识别安全风险。个例评估考虑患者人群、研究药物适应症、疾病自然史、现有治疗方法以及可能的获益-风险等因素。申办者还应当定期对安全性数据进行汇总分析，评估风险。
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: confirmed against the Chinese text: actor, modal ('应当' = shall) and content match. Below 90: Chinese quote with English statement (translation). Bilingual review: re-translation agrees; level follows the Chinese modal (应当/应/不得); statement adds nothing; earlier hold below 90 for being a translation is lifted per GUIDE "Non-English sources".
rows.quote_en: Article 128 The sponsor shall analyse and assess safety information and identify safety risks. Individual case assessment considers factors such as the patient population, the indication of the investigational drug, the natural history of the disease, existing treatments and the possible benefits and risks. The sponsor shall also periodically conduct aggregate analyses of safety data and assess risks.

f.title: Submit DSURs annually per the DSUR standard
f.statement: During trials, the sponsor shall conduct an annual review of drug-related safety information and submit DSURs on time; DSURs and annexes shall be written in full per the DSUR management standard and cover all dosage forms and strengths, indications and subject populations.

rows.actor: Sponsor (drug registration applicant approved to conduct clinical trials)
rows.deadline: Annually
rows.quote: 第一百二十九条 　临床试验期间，申办者应当对报告周期内收集到的与药物相关的安全性信息进行全面深入的年度回顾、汇总和评估，按时提交研发期间安全性更新报告，研发期间安全性更新报告及其附件应当严格按照《研发期间安全性更新报告管理规范》完整撰写，并应包含与所有剂型和规格、所有适应症以及研究中接受试验药物的受试人群相关的数据。
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: confirmed against the Chinese text: actor, modal ('应当' = shall) and content match. Below 90: Chinese quote with English statement (translation). Bilingual review: re-translation agrees; level follows the Chinese modal (应当/应/不得); statement adds nothing; earlier hold below 90 for being a translation is lifted per GUIDE "Non-English sources".
rows.quote_en: Article 129 During clinical trials, the sponsor shall conduct a comprehensive and in-depth annual review, compilation and assessment of drug-related safety information collected during the reporting period and submit the development safety update report [研发期间安全性更新报告] on time; the development safety update report and its annexes shall be written completely and strictly in accordance with the Standard for the Management of Development Safety Update Reports [《研发期间安全性更新报告管理规范》] and shall contain data relating to all dosage forms and strengths, all indications and the subject populations receiving the investigational drug in the studies.

f.title: DSUR period starts at the DIBD; first DSUR within two months of first DIBD after approval
f.statement: In principle the first clinical trial approval date in China or globally (DIBD) is the start of the DSUR period; the first DSUR shall be submitted within two months after the first DIBD following approval of trials in China.

rows.actor: Sponsor (drug registration applicant approved to conduct clinical trials)
rows.deadline: First DSUR within two months after the first DIBD following approval of trials in China
rows.quote: 原则上，应当将药物在境内或全球首次获得临床试验许可日期（即国际研发诞生日）作为研发期间安全性更新报告报告周期的起始日期。首次提交研发期间安全性更新报告应当在境内临床试验获准开展后第一个国际研发诞生日后两个月内完成。
rows.review_note: Review: no change. '原则上' qualifies only the choice of the DIBD as the period start; the two-month first-submission deadline is an unqualified '应当' (Mandatory). Double-check: confirmed. Below 90: Chinese quote with English statement (translation). Also: '原则上' qualifies the DIBD as start date (a judgement on level); the two-month first-DSUR deadline is an unqualified '应当'. Deadline wording checked: within two months after the first DIBD following approval of trials in China. Bilingual review: re-translation agrees; held at 85: 原则上 qualifies the start date.
rows.quote_en: In principle, the date on which the drug first obtained clinical trial authorisation in China or globally (the development international birth date) shall be used as the start date of the reporting period of the development safety update report. The first development safety update report shall be submitted within two months after the first development international birth date following approval to conduct clinical trials in China.

deadline_rule.clock_start: 境内临床试验获准开展后第一个国际研发诞生日

f.title: DSUR may align to the international birth date once marketed
f.statement: When the drug is approved for marketing in or outside China, the sponsor may, if needed, prepare and submit the safety update report based on the international birth date; for the first adjusted submission the reporting period shall not exceed one year.
f.exceptions: First adjusted reporting period shall not exceed one year ('不应超过一年').

rows.actor: Sponsor (drug registration applicant approved to conduct clinical trials)
rows.quote: 当药物在境内外获得上市许可，如申办者需要，可在该药品全球首个获得上市批准日期的基础上准备和提交安全性更新报告。调整后的首次提交，报告周期不应超过一年。
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Permitted ('可'); the one-year cap on the first adjusted period ('不应超过一年') is a binding condition on using the permission and is kept in exceptions. Double-check: confirmed. Below 90: Chinese quote with English statement (translation). Also: Permitted ('可'), conditional on need; the cap '不应超过一年' is translated 'shall not' for consistency with row 0054. Bilingual review: re-translation agrees; held at 82: row mixes 可 (Permitted) with 不应 (shall not) for the first adjusted period.
rows.quote_en: When the drug obtains marketing authorisation in or outside China, the sponsor may, if needed, prepare and submit the safety update report on the basis of the date of the drug's first marketing approval worldwide. For the first submission after this adjustment, the reporting period shall not exceed one year.

f.title: Modify, suspend or terminate trials according to risk
f.statement: Where the sponsor assesses some safety risk, it shall take measures such as amending the protocol, investigator brochure or informed consent; for a greater risk it shall proactively suspend the trial; for a major risk it shall proactively terminate it. Related information shall be updated promptly on the clinical trial registration and publication platform.
f.systems: Drug clinical trial registration and information publication platform
f.processes: Clinical safety monitoring; Risk management & minimisation

rows.actor: Sponsor (drug registration applicant approved to conduct clinical trials)
rows.quote:
第一百三十条 　申办者经评估认为临床试验存在一定安全风险的，应当采取修改临床试验方案、修改研究者手册、修改知情同意书等风险控制措施；评估认为临床试验存在较大安全风险的，应当主动暂停临床试验；评估认为临床试验存在重大安全风险的，应当主动终止临床试验。
 修改临床试验方案、主动暂停或终止临床试验等相关信息，应当按照相关要求及时在药物临床试验登记与信息公示平台进行更新。
systems: Drug clinical trial registration and information publication platform
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: confirmed against the Chinese text: actor, modal ('应当' = shall) and content match. Below 90: Chinese quote with English statement (translation). Bilingual review: re-translation agrees; level follows the Chinese modal (应当/应/不得); statement adds nothing; earlier hold below 90 for being a translation is lifted per GUIDE "Non-English sources".
rows.quote_en:
Article 130 Where the sponsor's assessment concludes that the clinical trial carries a certain safety risk, it shall take risk-control measures such as amending the clinical trial protocol, amending the investigator's brochure and amending the informed consent form; where the assessment concludes that the clinical trial carries a considerable safety risk, it shall suspend the clinical trial on its own initiative; where the assessment concludes that the clinical trial carries a major safety risk, it shall terminate the clinical trial on its own initiative.
Information on amendments to the clinical trial protocol, voluntary suspension or termination of the clinical trial, etc. shall be updated promptly on the Drug Clinical Trial Registration and Information Disclosure Platform [药物临床试验登记与信息公示平台] in accordance with the relevant requirements.

f.title: Evaluate effectiveness of trial risk-control measures
f.statement: The sponsor shall evaluate implementation and effectiveness of risk-control measures and decide on further action.
f.processes: Clinical safety monitoring; Risk management & minimisation

rows.actor: Sponsor (drug registration applicant approved to conduct clinical trials)
rows.quote: 第一百三十一条 　申办者应当对风险控制措施的执行情况和实施效果进行评估，并根据评估结论决定是否采取进一步行动。
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: confirmed against the Chinese text: actor, modal ('应当' = shall) and content match. Below 90: Chinese quote with English statement (translation). Bilingual review: re-translation agrees; level follows the Chinese modal (应当/应/不得); statement adds nothing; earlier hold below 90 for being a translation is lifted per GUIDE "Non-English sources".
rows.quote_en: Article 131 The sponsor shall assess the implementation and effectiveness of risk-control measures and decide on the basis of the assessment conclusions whether further action is needed.

f.title: Definition: ADR cluster event (same or adjacent batch, short period, similar reactions, suspected quality or other safety risk)
f.statement: An ADR cluster event is an event in which multiple suspected adverse reactions with similar clinical manifestations occur in a concentrated way within a short period for the same drug of the same batch number (or adjacent batch numbers), showing clustering, and which is suspected to be quality-related or may involve other safety risks.
f.applicability: Defines the trigger for the cluster-event investigation and reporting duties in Arts. 61 and 89 (rows 0072 and 0100).

rows.quote: 药品不良反应聚集性事件：是指同一批号（或相邻批号）的同一药品在短期内集中出现多例临床表现相似的疑似不良反应，呈现聚集性特点，且怀疑与质量相关或可能存在其他安全风险的事件。
rows.review_note: Review: new row: the Art. 132 definition of 'ADR cluster event' sets when the Art. 89 immediate investigation and provincial reporting duty applies, so it is curated under the guide's definition rule. The other Art. 132 definitions (ADR, signal, identified and potential risk) are not curated: they do not change what must be reported (Art. 47 already widens reporting beyond the ADR definition). Double-check: confirmed. Below 90: Chinese quote with English statement (translation). Also: definition row with no actor or modal; its value is as the trigger of Arts. 61 and 89 (rows 0072, 0100); MAH actor inferred. Bilingual review: re-translation agrees; held at 72: definition only; relevance via cluster-event duties.
rows.quote_en: Adverse drug reaction cluster event: an event in which multiple suspected adverse reactions with similar clinical manifestations occur in a short period with the same drug of the same batch number (or adjacent batch numbers), showing clustering, and are suspected to be related to quality or may involve other safety risks.

dates.quote: 一、《药物警戒质量管理规范》自2021年12月1日起正式施行。
dates.quote_en: 1. The Good Pharmacovigilance Practice shall formally enter into force on 1 December 2021.

dates.quote: 三、药品上市许可持有人应当自本公告发布之日起60日内，在国家药品不良反应监测系统中完成信息注册。
dates.quote_en: 3. Drug marketing authorisation holders shall complete information registration in the national adverse drug reaction monitoring system within 60 days from the date this announcement is issued (announcement dated 7 May 2021).
